scope: Form navigation and inspection fixes, restored dictation and consistent list boundaries.

topics.title: Address and password dictation restored
details: Website addresses, email addresses and passwords can again be dictated. Email and URL fields normalize spoken at, dot and slash. Passwords remain masked in page text, form review and recognized-input feedback. Guided forms include password and address fields.

topics.title: Revisiting edited form fields
details: Extraction and live control checks now use the same field labels. Unlabelled fields receive a nearby prompt or field-name fallback instead of using entered text as their identity. Control keys persist across captures when surrounding controls are added. Tab and Shift+Tab can revisit edited answers without a false page-changed warning.

topics.title: Readable form inspection and submission
details: Previously skipped unlabelled fields are included in form review and required-field inspection. Regression tests reproduce the structure of the Blind MAST contact form, revisit all four answers and verify an isolated submission response. The live contact form is checked without sending a message.

topics.title: Home and End at list boundaries
details: Home and End announce the destination item when moving. Repeating the key at that endpoint announces Start of list or End of list, matching an additional arrow attempt. This applies to menus, email message lists, media lists and browser choices.

topics.title: Microphone rollback retained
details: The default Windows microphone remains available without the external-only hardware safeguard removed in 0.2.119-test.
